name: Ierissos Town Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy, gentle slope, shallow near shore.
bar_notes: Several cafes/tavernas along the beach road.
notes: The main town beach, faces the open Strymonic/Ierissos Gulf so it takes the full force of easterly winds. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Nea Roda Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy and shallow, quieter than Ierissos town beach.
bar_notes: Tavernas and a couple of beach bars near the village.
notes: On the Strymonic/Ierissos Gulf side of the isthmus, so exposed to the same wind direction as Ierissos. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Ouranoupoli Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy town beach, shallow entry, lots of shade options.
bar_notes: Busy promenade with many cafes, bars and restaurants, plus toilets.
notes: Faces the Singitic Gulf (west side of the isthmus) - the opposite side from Ierissos, so it's often calm when Ierissos has easterly wind, and vice versa. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Trypiti Beach
toddler_notes: Small sandy cove, shallow, generally calm water.
bar_notes: Well-known beach bar right on the sand.
notes: The northern end of the same beach strip as Ouranoupoli (they're continuous), just before the Ammouliani ferry port. Position is an estimate anchored to Ouranoupoli's verified coordinates, not independently confirmed - double-check on a map before relying on it for turn-by-turn directions.

name: Alykes Beach, Ammouliani
toddler_notes: Shallow, calm, turquoise water - very good for small kids.
notes: On the western/southwestern coast of Ammouliani island, overlooking Sithonia. Requires the short ferry from Tripiti (~15 min crossing) plus driving. Position is estimated from the island's verified center coordinates (Wikipedia), not the exact beach - double-check on a map before relying on it for directions.

name: Megali Ammos Beach, Ammouliani
toddler_notes: Wide white-sand beach, very shallow water - one of the best for small children on the island.
notes: The southernmost beach on Ammouliani island, facing the Drenia islets and Ouranoupoli. Same ferry trip as Alykes Beach. Position is estimated from the island's verified center coordinates (Wikipedia), not the exact beach - double-check on a map before relying on it for directions.

name: Pyrgadikia Beach
toddler_notes: Small, calm fishing-village beach, shallow water.
bar_notes: A couple of tavernas by the water.
notes: On the Singitic Gulf coast (same side as Ouranoupoli/Ammouliani, not the Strymonic side like Ierissos), further southwest toward the base of Sithonia. Meaningfully further than Ouranoupoli/Ammouliani and possibly a longer, winding drive - confirm the route and travel time before heading out. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Stratoni Beach
notes: North of Ierissos on the same Strymonic Gulf coast, so same wind exposure. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Stavros Beach
bar_notes: Several beach bars and tavernas along the front.
notes: Further north up the Strymonic Gulf coast, technically in the Thessaloniki regional unit rather than Chalkidiki - only worth the drive if you're exploring further afield. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Vourvourou (Karidi/Lagoon area)
toddler_notes: Shallow lagoon partly sheltered by Diaporos island - one of the calmest, most toddler-friendly spots in the area.
notes: On the east coast of Sithonia, between Ormos Panagias and Sarti - worth the longer drive on a genuinely windy day since the lagoon stays calm more often than open beaches. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Sarti Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, shallow, but open to the gulf so more affected by wind.
bar_notes: Lots of beach bars and restaurants along the promenade.
notes: Open bay on Sithonia's east coast - only calm when wind isn't from the east. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Toroni Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy bay, shallow water, easy for little ones.
bar_notes: Tavernas and beach bars along the bay.
notes: At the southwest tip of Sithonia on the Toronean Gulf - west-facing, so it can be calm when the east coast is choppy. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Possidi Beach
toddler_notes: Shallow sandbar/lagoon, one of the best in the region for toddlers.
notes: On the Kassandra peninsula - a long drive from Ierissos, only realistic if you're already over there that day. Coordinates verified against Wikidata.

name: Sani Beach
toddler_notes: Organized resort beach, shallow and calm, lifeguards.
notes: On the Kassandra peninsula - a long drive from Ierissos, only realistic if you're already over there that day. Coordinates verified against the resort's published location.
